title: “Crash Test Dummies” for AI-Enabled Clinical Assessment: Validating Virtual Patient Scenarios with Virtual Learners

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a Bayesian hierarchical rater-mediated signal detection theory (HRM-SDT) model to transcript-based ordinal ratings to isolate and estimate rater-specific decision thresholds (severity and leniency criteria) and detection sensitivity across different clinical competencies.
